title: Language-model agents' beliefs can be manipulated via truthful evidence in open channel
abstract: arXiv:2611.21235v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Language-model agents' beliefs can be manipulated through open channels such as social media, even when the information they receive is truthful. When agents fill gaps between fragments with self-induced relationships, they may accept those relationships as established facts and pass the resulting rumours to others. Drawing on cognitive theory of narrative understanding and film theory of montage, we introduce Generative Montage to operationalize this failure, termed narrative overfitting, by coordinating agents to arrange truthful fragments into misleading narratives. Across 1,090 rumour targets from six Twitter events, agents often accepted rumours overconfidently, with overall acceptance exceeding 65 percent in twelve of fourteen models. Acceptance remained above 50 percent after majority voting or review of the same evidence, showing how errors can reach downstream decisions. translated_title: 语言模型智能体的信念可通过开放信道中的真实证据被操纵
translated_abstract: 语言模型智能体的信念可以通过社交媒体等开放信道被操纵，即使它们接收到的信息是真实的。当智能体用自我诱导的关系填补信息片段之间的空白时，它们可能会将这些关系当作已确立的事实接受，并将由此产生的谣言传递给他人。借鉴叙事理解的认知理论和电影蒙太奇理论，我们提出了“生成式蒙太奇”来操作化这一被称为“叙事过拟合”的失败模式，通过协调智能体将真实的片段排列成具有误导性的叙事。在来自六个Twitter事件的1,090个谣言目标上，智能体经常过度自信地接受谣言，在14个模型中有12个模型的整体接受率超过65%。在经过多数投票或对相同证据进行审查后，接受率仍保持在50%以上，这表明此类错误如何能够传播到下游决策中。为解释这种易感性，片段干预实验……
tldr: 该论文提出“生成式蒙太奇”方法，证明即使仅使用真实的证据片段，也能通过诱导语言模型智能体产生“叙事过拟合”而使其过度自信地接受并传播谣言，且多数投票等审查机制难以纠正这一错误。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces Generative Montage, demonstrating that language-model agents can be manipulated into overconfidently accepting and spreading rumors through truthful evidence fragments alone via "narrative overfitting," an error that persists even under majority voting or evidence review.
